The owner admits he has not tracked material/energy since the 2022 peak (doc:20260724-70230-M1) and offered to open his calculation (doc:20260809-70230-M3). Cash is tight: overdue complaint (doc:20260812-70230-P) and request to pay in 10 days for a discount (doc:20260912-70230-M2).
